annotation.bound_parties_text: The statute binds any "person" who operates drones or allows them to contact or approach protected sites, and bars political subdivisions from regulating unmanned aircraft systems or drone delivery services.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: A person may not knowingly or willfully: Operate a drone over a critical infrastructure facility
annotation.robot_provision_quote: 330.41 Unmanned Aircraft Systems Act. (1) SHORT TITLE. This act may be cited as the “Unmanned Aircraft Systems Act.”
